commit: local commit containing this report; not pushed
summary: Completed repository-side deployment hardening, preflight, and contract tests. Docker Desktop was started hidden and both official base images were pulled, but the real backend image build did not finish/verify within the available time, so no compose smoke, readiness, SSE-through-nginx, admin-through-proxy, persistence-after-rebuild, or runtime log/token check is claimed.

changes.change: Keep the pinned Python 3.11 non-root image; install libgomp1 after the pip layer so PyTorch/onnxruntime imports do not depend on host toolchains and native-library fixes do not invalidate cached dependency downloads.
Add backend stop_grace_period: 30s so SIGTERM can drain in-flight SSE before Docker sends SIGKILL; keep backend internal-only and nginx as the only published port.

Write runtime.env, instance.json, and current.json with same-directory temp file + fsync + os.replace, mode 0600 for credential/config files; reject provider credential values containing newlines. Secrets still come only from the server environment.
Generated serve.py now explicitly uses one uvicorn worker and a 10s graceful-shutdown timeout, matching the process-local session store and handoff file locks.
Same explicit single-worker and graceful-shutdown settings in the direct server entry.

Add minimal stdlib-only preflight/up/down/smoke helper. It reads only the explicit env file, checks tokens/assets/port/daemon/compose config without printing values, uses an isolated compose project for smoke, never passes -v on down, and checks HTTP/SSE/admin/logs without calling the model.
Document preflight, isolated project/port/volume smoke commands, zero-model-cost handoff SSE flow, and the single-uvicorn-worker constraint. No claim of a completed deploy.
Add regression coverage for stop_grace_period, atomic 0600 entrypoint writes, generated single-worker entry, env parsing, distinct-token enforcement, and no token echo in preflight output.
